label: loop
description: RET-2 niche: the agent is stuck hammering one tool (search) with genuinely different queries every time and mixed success/failure results. Exact-match RET-1 and the LoopDetector both stay silent (each canonical token differs), yet one tool dominates the recent window. Lives outside traces/ on purpose: RET-2's confidence is capped below stop_threshold, so this storm never STOPs on its own -- it only reinforces a stop via fusion -- and therefore cannot serve as a must-be-caught golden loop trace.
